opening.argument: The speaker promotes a Bitconnect lending opportunity while presenting reported investment earnings as a way to make money. The dashboard shows $400.00 invested, $49.39 in lending profit, and $49.39 total earned, while he says, “this is all interest that I grew no from compound compound so it is possible to make money without getting referrals all you have to do is compound.” He directs viewers to sign up through the description, join his team, and “get this money together,” with a referral-linked Bitconnect URL. He also discusses referrals and loans, and separately solicits donations to his Bitconnect wallet. Together, these are direct solicitations tied to investment returns, team recruitment, and referral activity.
